content:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — candidate @carlos for ML Infra scheduled Tue 11:00am PT. We need 3 interviewers + scribe. Jordan, can you confirm you're still on?
Maya: I can take the syst/infra chunk if Jordan needs to swap.
Samir: I’m on for design + take-home review.
Jordan: I can still make Tue but might be late by 10 min. If so pls start with code walkthrough.
Aisha: Appreciate it. @Priya can you be scribe if Jordan is late? It'll just be notes + score capture.
Priya: Yep I can scribe. Quick Q: are we evaluating take-home as part of the interview or separately? Need rubric clarity.
Samir: We usually fold take-home into technical — 50% of score. But might be worth calling out exact expectations to the other panelists.
Maya: +1. Also remind folks to review candidate packet: https://drive.redwood.internal/interviews/carlos-mlinfra — 1 pager + take-home link.
Aisha: Here’s the rubric we'll use — please skim before Tue:
```
technical: 50
system_design: 20
collab: 15
communication: 15
notes_required: true
```
Jordan: Thanks — I'll review packet tonight. If I'm >10m late, start with 15m code task then move to design.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Candidate materials and Zoom link sent to panelists — please acknowledge in channel. :bell:
Maya: Ack.
Samir: Ack.
Priya: Ack — I’ll set up the scribe doc and post link in thread by EOD.
Aisha: Perfect. One more tiny ask — if you see any red flags in take-home, drop a short note in the scribe doc under concerns so debrief is faster.
Priya: Will do. Link to scribe doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/scribe/carlos-mlinfra-notes
Aisha: Thanks everyone. If Jordan ends up fully out, @Maya can you cover intro and wrap?
Maya: Yep I can. :+1:
